_help: Add one object to 'sessions' for every workshop date. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. 'slots' are the daily time blocks [start, end] (24h). Past sessions disappear by themselves after their end date. English and German pages both read this file.

description.en: Two-day classical Hatha Yoga workshop on Yogasanas, structured by Sadhguru and taught by Nanda in Kollbrunn near Zurich. Two 2.5-hour sessions per day. No prior experience required.
description.de: Zweitägiger Workshop zu klassischen Hatha-Yoga-Yogasanas nach der Struktur von Sadhguru, unterrichtet von Nanda in Kollbrunn bei Zürich. Zwei 2,5-stündige Einheiten pro Tag. Keine Vorerfahrung erforderlich.
